Regulatory certainty remains a critical pillar for the rapid deployment of utility-scale and commercial solar infrastructure across India. The Manufacture and Other Operations in Warehouse (MOOWR) Regulations, 2019, have historically offered clean energy developers significant financial flexibility by deferring customs duties on imported capital goods and raw materials used in manufacturing and bonded operations. However, regulatory shifts and subsequent notifications often create friction between developers and fiscal authorities.
